claude_proposed_widenings.name: multi_family_mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring co-presents three distinct mechanic families on one item: a passive grant (Elemental Bane), a Magic-action save-gate activation (Elemental Compulsion), and a charge-pool spellcasting system (Spellcasting). MagicItemMechanics = PassiveMechanics | ActivatedAbilityMechanics permits only one family per record. Even the two-family base case (passive + activation) is already irrepresentable.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties: Elemental Bane [passive] ... Elemental Compulsion [Magic action save gate] ... Spellcasting. The ring has 5 charges [charge pool].

claude_proposed_widenings.name: plane_conditional_grants
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Elemental Focus properties and spell lists are conditionally active based on the ring's linked Elemental Plane (Air / Earth / Fire / Water). No current surface type models a plane-variant or enum-keyed conditional passive grant set. This is a GM-determined selection at item acquisition, not a cast-time CastTimeChoice.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Elemental Focus. While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane: Air. [...] Earth. [...] Fire. [...] Water. [...]

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_language
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Four Elemental Focus variants grant knowledge of an elemental language (Auran, Terran, Ignan, Aquan). No language-grant atom exists in EffectAtom or anywhere in the current surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Air: You know Auran. / Earth: You know Terran. / Fire: You know Ignan. / Water: You know Aquan.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: difficult_terrain_exception
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Earth variant: terrain composed of rubble, rocks, or dirt is not Difficult Terrain for the wearer. No existing atom models conditional exemptions from difficult terrain movement penalties for specific terrain types.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Terrain composed of rubble, rocks, or dirt isn't Difficult Terrain for you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: pass_through_terrain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Earth variant grants the ability to move through solid earth or rock (treating it as difficult terrain, without disturbing the matter). This is not a speed mode (grant_speed covers fly/swim/climb/burrow) — it is a phasing-style movement through solid matter. No existing atom covers this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can move through solid earth or rock as if those areas were Difficult Terrain without disturbing the matter through which you pass. If you end your turn in solid earth or rock, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space you last occupied.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: breathe_underwater
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Water variant grants the ability to breathe underwater. No atom models alternate breathing environments. Distinct from grant_sense (darkvision/blindsight) and grant_speed (swim speed is a separate co-present grant).
